description: Darkroom phases (compose, commit, finish), full-body values: 12 steps, guidance 1.0 until the face locks, the identity LoRA weight 1.0 -> 1.2 over the commit window, guidance 2.0 with the negative prompt in the finish. No LoRA is required. Experimental.

source.source: the maintainers' recipe runs 12 steps; 8 is the sa2_8 schedule of their earlier turbo-phase test; other counts in 9-16 have no source

source.unit: dimensionless guidance scale of the compose and commit phases
source.source: compose guidance stays 1.0 (card CFG 1, Kromoss README line 140); above 1.1 has no card source; range as turbo_identity. The finish guidance is darkroom.finish.cfg

calibration.reference: none: darkroom phases have no native-graph equivalent (experimental); values from the maintainers' own runs

ui.label: candidate
ui.summary: Darkroom phases, full-body values: 12 steps, identity LoRA weight boost, finish guidance 2.0. LoRAs optional. Experimental.

sampling.steps.source: the maintainers' recipe darkroom_turbo_fullbody (12 steps, the portrait values under their own id); the maintainers' comparison of steps on full-body found no robust gain, value kept

sampling.shift.source: Kromoss README line 141 (Shift 5); native model shift 5.0 (comfy/supported_models.py:2042-2045)

sampling.cfg.source: Kromoss README line 140 (CFG 1) for the compose and commit phases; comfy/samplers.py:610-612 drops the uncond branch at cfg 1

sampling.slg_start.source: SLG off, window kept at the schema default 0..1: nodes_slg.py:149 makes SLG a no-op when uncond is None

sampling.slg_end.source: SLG off, window kept at the schema default 0..1 (inert while slg_mode is off)

budget.extra_forwards.source: no corrections, restart or detailer in v1 (SPEC 5, 6.1)

budget.max_forwards.source: override_bounds corner 16 steps x 2 branches (cfg > 1) = 32; the darkroom plan counts its own branches (1 until the finish, 2 in it)

darkroom.compose.cfg.source: equals sampling.cfg; compose and commit run one forward per step (compose phase of the maintainers' recipe)

darkroom.commit.r_c.source: the maintainers' recipe darkroom_turbo_fullbody@1: compose ends at r 0.06

darkroom.commit.r_k.source: the maintainers' recipe darkroom_turbo_fullbody@1: the face is locked at r 0.17; commit ends there

darkroom.commit.w_compose.source: the maintainers' recipe darkroom_turbo_fullbody@1: the nominal weight of the profile's character LoRA

darkroom.commit.w_commit.source: the maintainers' recipe darkroom_turbo_fullbody@1: 1.2 after commit (smoothstep over r_c..r_k); the maintainers' comparison of w_commit on full-body found no robust gain, value kept

darkroom.reexpose.sigma_r.source: the maintainers' runs: re-expose to sigma 0.8; off in this preset because it smoothed the result on MOSS

darkroom.finish.r_f.source: the maintainers' recipe darkroom_turbo_fullbody@1: the finish (negative prompt) starts at r 0.17, where the face is locked; the maintainers' comparison of r_f on full-body found no robust gain, value kept

darkroom.finish.cfg.source: the maintainers' measurements (cfg 2 with the negative prompt gave the texture); the maintainers' comparison of finish_cfg on full-body found no robust gain, value kept; two branches per step from r_f on

darkroom.finish.eta.source: the maintainers' recipe darkroom_turbo_fullbody@1: 0 (no noise injection in the finish); the maintainers' comparison of eta on full-body found no robust gain, value kept
